macros.name: arg
macros.doc: \arg takes as optional argument the index of the argument that is being marked up; if not they are used consecutively.

macros.name: cmhgraphics
macros.doc: \cmhgraphics additional wraps the image in a center-environment.

macros.name: comp
macros.doc: The \comp-macro marks components to be highlighted in a notation for a symbol taking (one or more) arguments.

macros.name: extref
macros.doc: Like \sref, but with the third argument mandatory, \extref will always produce the output as if ⟨label⟩ would not occur in the current document.

macros.name: IfInputref
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if we currently are in an \inputref or \mhinput, otherwise executes ⟨false⟩.

macros.name: ifstexhtml
macros.doc: \ifstexhtml conditional, which is true if the document is being compiled to HTML, and false if compiled to PDF.

macros.name: libusepackage
macros.doc: inputs all packages ⟨package name⟩.sty in the lib directories of the current archive.

macros.name: mhinput
macros.doc: Like \inputref, but actually calls \input in both PDF and HTML mode.

macros.name: notation
macros.doc: introduces a new notation for the referenced symbol. The starred variant \notation* sets this notation as the (new) default notation.

macros.name: premise
macros.doc: The \premise macro can be used to additionally mark up premises.

macros.name: sreflabel
macros.doc: \sreflabel {⟨label⟩} sets a label analogous to \label{⟨label⟩}, but for use in \sref.

macros.name: srefsetin
macros.doc: Sets a default value for the optional arguments ⟨archive2⟩, ⟨file2⟩ and ⟨title⟩ of \sref.

macros.name: stexdoctitle
macros.doc: Sets ⟨title⟩ to be the title of the document.

macros.name: STEXexport
macros.doc: executes the provided code every time the current module is opened (including immediately).

macros.name: STEXinvisible
macros.doc: Processes ⟨code⟩, but does not generate any output. In the HTML, ⟨code⟩ is exported with display:none.

macros.name: symuse
macros.doc: \symuse retrieves a symbol by name/id and invokes it as if using a semantic macro.

macros.name: textsymdecl
macros.doc: Like \symdecl, but requires that the symbol has arity 0 (hence \textsymdecl does not take the args-option), and generates a semantic macro that takes no arguments in either text or math mode, and produces marked-up ⟨code⟩ as output.

macros.name: this
macros.doc: Within an mathstructure or exstructure, or in the context of a particular instance of one, \this represents “the” instance.

envs.name: blindfragment
envs.doc: In the case where we want to increase the section level without producing a corresponding section header, the blindfragment environment can be used.

envs.name: sassertion
envs.doc: For assertions (i.e. theorems, lemmata, axioms, claims,...), STEX provides the sassertion environment.
